name: maui-notifications-deep-links
description: Implement MAUI notifications and deep links. USE FOR: local/push notifications, FCM HTTP v1 migration, APNs/Azure Notification Hubs, permission UX, Android channels/`POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, iOS `UNUserNotificationCenter`, token lifecycle, notification tap navigation, app links/universal links/URI schemes. DO NOT USE FOR: OAuth callbacks, generic Shell navigation, picker/location permissions.
